heading: We’re at our best when we’re making.
content: We’re at our best when we’re making.. A few beliefs that shape how we build at OpenLake. 01 Learning to code converts you from a consumer to a creator. Suddenly, computers become a tool for making things instead of just using them. 02 Anyone with a laptop and an internet connection can learn to build software. Making things has never been this democratized. 03 We want a space on campus where people are making interesting things with code, every week. Most places don't provide that, so we built it. 04 Most courses teach concepts instead of how to write real code — like learning carpentry without any wood. Here you learn entirely through shipping. 05 Starting out, you won't understand how all the code works. You'll build that understanding as you go, and you'll get stuck along the way. We're here for that part. Browse our projects 06 OpenLake gives you a room full of other people building things. We're designers, writers, engineers, tinkerers. We help one another. Join us. Jump straight into the community and pick up your first issue. Join the community Want the monthly recap?
